mechanism.claim: When both halves of a completed high-variation eight-hour BTC auction move in the same direction while absolute return per quote turnover rises materially in the second half, directional price discovery is accelerating into thinner liquidity rather than exhausting. Follow the confirmed direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of first-half and second-half open-to-close log returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVLIR ranks one hourly impact level and requires an onset. HVPIAR compares upside and downside bar impact within a block. HVTIER compares causal first-half versus second-half aggregate impact while separately requiring directional agreement; it reuses no event set or control and is not a repair of either terminal candidate.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed-block realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: conditional 00:05/08:05/16:05 UTC impact-escalation clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates in [D-8h,D), each from five unique 1m rows
features.half_return: log(last half close/first half open), finite, strict nonzero, and both halves have one common sign
features.half_quote_turnover: sum quote_asset_volume over each exact half, finite and positive
features.impact_escalation: second-half impact/first-half impact, finite and positive
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute log(close/open) returns), strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of impact_escalation and realized_variation over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 252; current excluded

clock.decision: exact block boundary after all source bars complete
clock.reservation: fixed blocks and holds are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block, half definition, impact formula, rank, history, threshold, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
